findings.detail: Resco Products fair_value was stored as 18,166.993 instead of the source value 18,166,993.
HOP Energy fair_value was stored as 21,218.503 instead of the source value 21,218,503.
Black Rock Coffee fair_value was stored as 18,551.101 instead of the source value 18,551,101.
Red Robin term loan fair_value was stored as 11,880.379 instead of the source value 11,880,379.

rationale: The X08 warnings are real data errors. For each flagged row, the source SOI shows fair value in full dollars and near amortized cost, not below 5% of cost. The extracted fair_values, 18,166.993, 21,218.503, 18,551.101, and 11,880.379, are exactly 1/1000 of the cited source fair values, while costs were extracted in full dollars. This is a fair_value unit scale defect, not distressed economics.
